name: Ekadantam Mahakayam
text:
एकदन्तं महाकायं तप्तकाञ्चनसन्निभम् ।
लम्बोदरं विशालाक्षं वन्देऽहं गणनायकम् ॥
meaning: I bow to Ganesha, who has one tusk and a vast body, shining like molten gold, with a large belly and wide eyes, the leader of the Ganas.
purpose: Praise of Ganesha’s distinctive form and obstacle-clearing role.
